PARENT_PRESPEC.why_this_is_an_addition_not_a_change: the security cohort was NEVER specified in any prespec. trigger, k_hub=4, B_SCALE=500, B_NULL=9999 and the definedness/stability semantics are untouched.

SECURITY_COHORT: the exact frozen 476-security V1 cohort on which the four hubs and the 732-member promoted family arose

COHORT_MEMBERSHIP.extracted_from: stageA_input.duckdb bars — the exact input surface of the historical inference

IDENTITY_AUTHORITY.ticker_role: METADATA ONLY — never part of key equality
IDENTITY_AUTHORITY.consequence: a ticker or name change does NOT create a new cohort member and is NOT a cohort addition, provided the lineage authority establishes the same security

IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED.rule: if continuity cannot be established by the lineage authority, the observation is UNAVAILABLE
IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED.FORBIDDEN: silently mapping it onto a new security, or onto an existing member

INHERITED_LIMITATION.from_identity_artifact: 474 of the 503 rest on an actual share-class identifier (CIK_PLUS_SHARE_CLASS_FIGI); 29 rest on the CIK being a SINGLETON inside this frozen universe — a weaker fact wearing the same shape
INHERITED_LIMITATION.within_the_476: NOT RESOLVED FROM THE ARTIFACTS AVAILABLE AT SEAL TIME — the key->basis mapping table was not located. The split must be reported before the first look, not assumed.

PROHIBITIONS.HISTORICALLY_EXCLUDED_27: FORBIDDEN in primary inference; no report-only extension is registered in V1
PROHIBITIONS.REPLACEMENT: FORBIDDEN — no substitute security is ever inserted for a lost member

ATTRITION.rule: a delisted, acquired or halted security REMAINS a member of the frozen 476 cohort and contributes only where observations are valid and available
ATTRITION.consequence: the cohort may naturally shrink in OBSERVABLE support during the forward window. That does NOT change cohort membership. The X-support census simply reflects real availability, and the 12-month backstop covers exactly this case.

DENOMINATOR_DISCIPLINE.OBSERVED_or_CONTRIBUTING_SECURITY_N: a REALIZED quantity for a given window / claim / hub
DENOMINATOR_DISCIPLINE.RULE: the two must never be conflated in any report. If in 2027 only 462 member securities have usable observations, the primary cohort is still 476 and 462 is realized availability/breadth — NOT a new universe.

A1_BOUNDARY_TEST.requirement: the forward ingest MUST NOT admit a new security merely because it appeared in the Massive universe
A1_BOUNDARY_TEST.mechanism: every security key in the primary forward pipeline passes a frozen-476 ALLOWLIST gate
A1_BOUNDARY_TEST.raw_data: may exist for other securities; it is simply not admitted to primary forward inference

ESTIMAND: replication in the same frozen security cohort
NOT_REGISTERED: generalisation to the excluded 27 (would be a separate registered extension branch)
